content: Many hospitals exhibit variability and inconsistency in the management of diabetes for inpatients. To address this issue, the implementation of standardized computerized provider order entry (CPOE) systems is recommended, along with conducting regular audits to ensure adherence to best practices. At the time of admission, an initial assessment should be performed to identify the specific type of diabetes the patient has, such as type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes, or other forms. This assessment should also evaluate the patient’s prior knowledge about diabetes, their behavioral patterns related to diabetes management, and their self-management needs. Furthermore, achieving optimal glycemic control prior to hospital admission can play a critical role in preventing complications, particularly in patients undergoing surgical procedures.
